# Marrowgate Produce - outbound pallets

One row per pallet leaving the dock. The September export retried twice, so two pallets
appear as an extra identical row; every field matches on the repeated rows.

# Cold-chain handling

Pallets stage in the 2-4 C bay and ride reefer trucks only. Weight is net produce weight
in kilograms, read at the dock scale.
